title: Hunting Down a Go Runtime Bug on 32-Bit Embedded Systems
summary: A technical deep-dive into discovering and debugging a network polling (netpoll) bug in the Go runtime specifically affecting 32-bit embedded systems. The article documents the investigation process of a low-level runtime issue that causes problems in resource-constrained environments.
problem_solved: Diagnoses and traces a bug in Go's network polling implementation that manifests only on 32-bit embedded platforms due to pointer/size handling differences.
why_valuable: Provides rare insights into Go runtime internals debugging and helps embedded developers avoid or fix similar issues in production IoT and embedded applications.
